settings.heading:
Born in the desert.
Made for every skin.
settings.text: DUNAS began with a simple question: what does skin really need when the air is dry, the sun is strong and the days are long? The answer became a small, considered range of rituals, made to be used every day.

settings.heading:
Care, shaped
by the climate.
settings.text:
We grew up between sand and sea, where skin is asked to do a lot. DUNAS is our answer: gentle formulas, honest ingredients and a short routine you actually keep.

Every product is tested through real summers and dry winters before it reaches you.

settings.title: Gentle
settings.text: Formulas that respect the skin barrier, every single day.

settings.title: Hydrating
settings.text: Moisture that lasts through dry air and long, warm days.

settings.title: Made for the climate
settings.text: Tested in real summers, not only in the lab.

settings.title: Honest
settings.text: Clear ingredient lists. Nothing hidden, nothing extra.

settings.caption: A promise we keep in every formula.

settings.heading:
Slow, small,
and on purpose.
settings.text: We make in small batches, so every formula is fresh and every detail is checked by hand. Fewer products, made properly, instead of a shelf of things you will never finish.

settings.title: Desert botanicals
settings.text: Plants that thrive in dry heat, and help skin do the same.

settings.title: Ceramides
settings.text: Support the barrier so moisture stays where it belongs.

settings.title: Mineral SPF
settings.text: Daily protection that feels light, even in the sun.

settings.heading:
Few ingredients.
Chosen with care.
settings.text: Each one earns its place in the formula.

settings.quote: I wanted a routine that felt like a breath of cool air at the end of a hot day. Simple, kind to the skin, and made for the place we live.
settings.name: The DUNAS founder

settings.heading:
Your skin,
every day.
settings.text: Discover the collection, made for the climate you live in.
